senses.gloss:
n. (-नं)
1 Hire, wages.
2 Livelihood, subsistence.
3 Silver.
E.
वी to go, तनन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नं)
Hiring, paying wages.
E.
वेतन, and दान giving.

n. (-नं)
Non-payment of wages.
E.
वेतन, and अदान not giving.

mf. (-सः-सी)
The ratan, (Calamus rotang.)
E.
वेञ् to sew or weave, Uṇādi aff. असच्, and तुक् augment.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The leaf of the ratan.
2 A lancet.
E.
वेतस, and पत्र a leaf.

mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्)
Reedy, abounding in reeds or canes, (a place or soil, &c.)
E.
वेतस् a cane, मतुप् aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A sprite, a goblin, especially one haunting cemeteries and animating dead bodies.
2 A door-keeper.
E.
व in the seventh case वे in air, and ताल habitation, fixation, from तल् to fix, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-त्ता-त्री-त्तृ)
1 Knowing, understanding, acquainted with.
2 Who obtains or acquires.
m. (-त्ता)
1 A sage, one who knows the nature of the soul and GOD.
2 A husband, an espouser.
E.
विद् to know, तृच् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
A reed, a cane, the Ratan.
n. (-त्रं)
A stick, a staff.
E.
वि to go, Uṇādi aff. त्र.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
A bounding with reeds or canes.
E.
वेत्र a cane, छ aff., and कुक् augment.

m. (-रः)
1 A door-keeper, a warder.
2 A staff-bearer, a mace-bearer.
E.
वेत्र a staff, and धर having.

m. (-कः)
1 A door-keeper, a warder, a porter.
2 A macebearer.
E.
वेत्र a stick, and धारक having.

f. (-ती)
The Betwa river, which rises in the province of Malva, and following a north-easterly direction for about 340 miles, falls into the Jumna below Calpi.
E.
वेत्र a ratan, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-नं)
A small cot or oblong low couch of basket work; when furnished with bambu sticks and a pole, it forms the common Duli or litter.
E.
वेत्र a cane, and आसन a seat.

m. (-त्री)
A porter, a door-keeper.
E.
वेत्र a strick, and इनि aff.
